audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text and spikes[2].text both call the shield 'Cozy Campfire shield' or attribute healing to 'Warm Hugs' — but per the kit, W Cozy Campfire is the heal-zone and E Warm Hugs is the shield. The two are swapped/conflated.
audit.why: enemyAbilities in the packet and enemyKit both list W: Cozy Campfire (heals allies in a zone) and E: Warm Hugs (shield + move speed, 2 charges). Cozy Campfire never shields.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text now says 'Warm Hugs shield'; spikes[2].text now correctly credits the heal to Cozy Campfire and the shield to Warm Hugs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[3-6].side are all 'Skill' while content win[3-5] already say 'Morgana' and win[6] says 'Milio' — four rows disagree, and phases[6].why literally reads 'Late Morgana erases playbooks', the opposite of what win[6]=Milio and whys[6] state.
audit.why: Content whys[3-6] are grounded (hard CC pressures his shields at 4-5, Soul Shackles beats his defensive ult at 6, item-window all-ins beat his sustain, but late his stacked heal/shield/cleanse ult overwhelms a single Q pick) and match the packet's own levelChart.
audit.corrected: phases[3-6].side moved to match win[] (Morgana, Morgana, Morgana, Milio); phases[3-6].why rewritten to state the actual reasoning instead of the unrelated templates.

audit.why: Level 2 pick window, level 6 R-vs-cleanse comparison, and first-item burst spike are all named with real ability references in spikes[].

edits.before: Milio has no hard CC to punish, so level 2 is about your Q: land Dark Binding on him or his ADC and you win the trade outright since his only defense is the Cozy Campfire shield and a slow. He'll poke with Ultra Mega Fire Kick, but that Q is dodgeable and gives you free positioning.
edits.after: Milio has no hard CC to punish, so level 2 is about your Q: land Dark Binding on him or his ADC and you win the trade outright since his only defense is the Warm Hugs shield and a slow. He'll poke with Ultra Mega Fire Kick, but that Q is dodgeable and gives you free positioning.

edits.before: With first item your poke damage outpaces his sustain in short windows; force all-ins rather than long poke wars, because his Warm Hugs shields and heals will out-sustain slow chip.
edits.after: With first item your poke damage outpaces his sustain in short windows; force all-ins rather than long poke wars, because his Cozy Campfire heal and Warm Hugs shields will out-sustain slow chip.

edits.before: Bank the root and shield the engage attempts — the lane plays at your Q's pleasure.
edits.after: Your hard CC out-pressures his shields through 4-5, so Dark Binding wins the trades your ADC needs.

edits.before: Soul Shackles online — close-range fights end in a double stun you started.
edits.after: Soul Shackles threatens more than his purely defensive ult — bait Breath of Life first and your R wins the fight.

edits.before: First item: the root converts and the shields multiply.
edits.after: First item keeps you ahead in burst-window all-ins over his slow sustain — force the fight rather than the poke war.

edits.before: Late Morgana erases playbooks: black-shield the engage's target and root the diver who insisted.
edits.after: Stacked heals, shields, and a CC-cleanse ult overwhelm your single-target pick late — burst before Breath of Life comes up or bait it out first.

edits.before: W the pair, bank the Q visibly, shield the answer — the threat governs while the pool bills.
edits.after: Land Dark Binding on him or his ADC while Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down — his Q's landing lag is your punish window.

edits.before: Q-poking into shields while their hook waits for yours to be down — the binding is the law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Black Shield holds no value against chip alone — save it for the all-in, or Milio bait-shields it for free.

edits.before: - Milio Breath of Life: matchup-defining — The team-wide cleanse-heal undoes your CC chain — force it early, engage after. It writes your spacing rules. - E Black Shield is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Milio Breath of Life: 160s at rank 1, 130s at rank 3 — the cleanse-heal undoes your CC chain, so force it early, engage after. - E Black Shield (26s early, 16s at rank 5) is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - R (120/110/100s) opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
